tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search for products available at local Calgary stores. Returns product name, store, price, stock level, and store categories. Use this when the user asks about finding, buying, or locating any product locally.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Check live stock level for a specific product. Optionally filter by store. If the caller's API key is a store-scoped partner key, the result is limited to that key's own store regardless of store_id.

tools.name: get_stores
tools.description: Get a list of local stores in Calgary with location info.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place an order for a single product from BuyNearby's own catalog (stores running the BuyNearby POS - stock/price are live and guaranteed). Requires API key authentication.
